result.reasoning: This commit refactored the reclaim() method in PatriciaTreeMutable.java, introducing local variables `actualNode`/`sourceNode` cached once at the start of the merge loop to replace repeated `actual.currentNode`/`source.currentNode` accesses. However, inside the loop, `source.moveDown()` mutates `source.currentNode`, so subsequent uses of the stale cached `sourceNode` variable (at the exact lines the fix touches) no longer reflect the updated node after moving down the tree. The fix reverts these specific lines back to using `source.currentNode` directly instead of the stale `sourceNode` reference, exactly undoing the faulty part of this refactor.
